services.name: tollbooth-oauth2-collector
services.description: Holds OAuth2 authorization codes, sealed to the operator that asked, until that operator's MCP collects them once.

services.name: tollbooth-oauth2-callback
services.description: The browser callback OAuth providers redirect to. It turns their GET redirect into the POST an MCP takes and hands the code to the collector.

notes: Registered as community utility Advocate via Oracle
